entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.code_description: Binoculars, monoculars, other optical telescopes, and mountings therefor; other astronomical instruments and mountings therefor, but not including instruments for radio-astronomy
entries.comment: Aids for the blind and partially sighted: spectacles for the correction of vision; spectacle lenses; binoculars for the visually impaired; magnifying glasses for the visually impaired; lenses and Fresnel prisms and accessories for prisms; contact lenses; sticks for the blind
